ItemID: NA; Title: Wrecking Ball; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Springsteen's roots-oriented rock sounds relevant, though I would only pick one album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Til Your River Runs Dry; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Eric Burdon's blues and rock approach fits my interest in Clapton and Hendrix, but it is a secondary choice today.
